The '''central volcano''' was a giant [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] near the [[Mensix Mining Facility/Legends|Mensix Mining Facility]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. On the ever-changing landscape of the lava [[Planet/Legends|planet]], the massive volcano was an invaluable landmark, and many lost [[Miner/Legends|miners]] were thankful for its presence to help guide them home. An old steel bridge built by [[Klegger Corporation]]. connected the volcano with the southern part of the [[Burning Plains/Legends|Burning Plains]].

Close to 20,000 gallons of lava per second flowed into the lava pools below the volcano. As the resources in this lava were of very poor quality, the majority of the mining operations were located in the higher grounds to the south.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] discovered the wreckage of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] [[Unidentified Hammerhead-class cruiser|cruiser]] near the lava streams that flowed from the top of the volcano. During their excavation of the cruiser, a [[Kubaza beetle cavern|cavern]] was built by the Separatists that later became a hive for [[Kubaza beetle/Legends|kubaza beetles]] following their departure. After a field crew of miners was killed by the beetles, [[Milo Mensix]] ordered the cave to be closed.

==Behind the scenes==
The Central volcano appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TCV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Central volcano was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:TCV" />
